title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: policy alert improvements
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned alert improvements from existing documented controls. The roadmap dates, Message Center rollout details, default availability and eligible subscription licensing are supported; a minor checklist-to-controls-table gap remains.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes improvements to Communication Compliance alerting capabilities and customisation.
claims.quote: This feature is about improving the alerting capabilities and customization in Communication Compliance.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether existing policies retain their current alert behaviour when the new page arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "alert settings" "roles" "existing". Read MC920304 and the roadmap; opened communication-compliance-policies and communication-compliance-configure. None specifies migration or changed defaults for existing policy alerts.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The supplied descriptions of the alert improvements identify no new data source or new data access.
claims.quote: Admins will be able to customize the alert frequency per policy as well as adjust the email alerts frequency and recipients within the policy creation wizard by navigating to the new alerts page.

claims.claim: MC920304 states that usernames are pseudonymised by default.
claims.quote: Usernames are pseudonymized by default

claims.claim: MC920304 states that role-based access controls are built in.
claims.quote: role-based access controls are built in

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Users assigned the Communication Compliance Admins role can set up policies.
claims.quote: Users assigned the Communication Compliance Admins role can set up policies and access the Communication Compliance page and global settings in Microsoft Purview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Roles; Open questions
claims.claim: The roles specifically authorised to change the new alert settings are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "alert settings" "roles" "existing". Read MC920304; opened communication-compliance-policies and communication-compliance-configure. These give policy roles but no role requirements specific to the new alerts page.

claims.claim: The supplied Message Center post does not specify the content of an alert email.
claims.quote: adjust the email alerts frequency and recipients within the policy creation wizard by navigating to the new alerts page.

claims.claim: The description of these alert improvements identifies no autonomous remediation action.
claims.quote: Communication Compliance is improving the capabilities and customization of policy alerts.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Why it matters
claims.claim: Communication Compliance detections are reviewed by human investigators who can take remediation actions.
claims.quote: With role-based access controls, human investigators can take remediation actions such as removing a message from Teams or notifying senders of potentially inappropriate conduct.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate additional licence requirement is documented specifically for these alert improvements as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "alert improvements" licensing billing disable tenant. Opened Microsoft Purview service description, communication-compliance-configure and purview-billing-models; read MC920304. No alert-improvement-specific licence requirement was stated.

claims.claim: Administrators must verify that the organisation has a supported subscription.
claims.quote: To access and use Communication Compliance, administrators need to verify that their organization has a supported subscription

claims.claim: Administrators must verify that users have appropriate licences assigned; Learn links to subscription requirements.
claims.quote: and that users have the appropriate licenses assigned. For more information about subscriptions and licensing, see the subscription requirements for Communication Compliance.

claims.claim: Detecting inappropriate or risky interactions in non-Microsoft 365 AI data requires enabling pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.quote: Additionally, to detect inappropriate or risky interactions for non-Microsoft 365 AI data, you need to enable pay-as-you-go billing in your organization.

claims.claim: Detecting inappropriate or risky interactions for Microsoft 365 Copilot data has no pay-as-you-go billing requirements or charges.
claims.quote: There aren't any pay-as-you-go billing requirements or charges for Microsoft 365 detecting inappropriate or risky interaction for Microsoft 365 Copilot data.

claims.claim: No meter specific to the alert improvements is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "alert improvements" licensing billing disable tenant. Opened communication-compliance-configure, Microsoft Purview service description and purview-billing-models. The latter meters non-Microsoft 365 AI scanning, not these alert settings.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Existing activity-count, activity-period and specific-user alert triggers can be changed on the Alert policies page in Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: You can change the default settings for triggers on number of activities, period for the activities, and for specific users in alert policies on the Alert policies page in Microsoft Purview.

claims.where: controls[0].api and note; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls
claims.claim: No automation for this Communication Compliance alert-trigger control is documented, and Learn says PowerShell policy management is unsupported.
claims.quote: Searched: Communication Compliance alert policies PowerShell Set-ProtectionAlert aggregation threshold notification recipients. Opened communication-compliance-policies and Set-ProtectionAlert: policy PowerShell is unsupported; the cmdlet only modifies alerts created using New-ProtectionAlert.

claims.claim: A tenant-wide UI or API switch for the new alert frequency and recipient settings is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "alert frequency" "disable"; "Communication Compliance" "alert" "Microsoft Graph" API frequency tenant switch. Read MC920304; opened policy and configuration pages and Set-ProtectionAlert. No tenant-wide feature switch was documented.

claims.claim: Communication Compliance alert policies have a minimum activity threshold of 3.
claims.quote: The alert policy threshold trigger settings for activities support a minimum value of 3 or higher for Communication Compliance policies.

claims.claim: No API for the new alert settings is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Communication Compliance new alerts page alert frequency recipients policy tenant switch API PowerShell; "Communication Compliance" "alert" "Microsoft Graph" API frequency tenant switch. Opened policy/configuration pages and Set-ProtectionAlert; no API for the new settings appeared.

claims.claim: Learn does not state that the new alerts page replaces the existing alert-trigger controls.
claims.quote: Searched: "Communication Compliance" "new alerts" "frequency"; "Communication Compliance" "alert settings" "roles" "existing". Opened communication-compliance-policies and communication-compliance-configure. Existing triggers are described without a replacement statement.

claims.claim: The governance checklist names controls that are not represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Confirm who is in the Communication Compliance Admins role group' and 'Set frequency and recipients per policy'. Table: existing alert policy triggers and a tenant-wide switch only.
claims.fix: The Before rollout role-group membership check and At rollout per-policy frequency/recipient configuration step have no corresponding controls-table rows; neither is represented by the existing-trigger or tenant-switch row.

controlChecks.governs: Alert policy triggers for a Communication Compliance policy: number of activities, period and specific users
